notes: Retimed 15.0s → 12.0s. The film's one pull-back: no device, so there is no in-phone camera here to remove — the camera lives on the STAGE (.f09-world, single-wrapper T = -offset x S) and is unchanged in kind. The traverse keeps all four stops and still names each station on arrival; the 3s came out of the dwell after each name lands and out of the tail, so the camera never travels faster per move than it did at 15s. Layout: .f09-stage now uses the film-wide 42px 80px stage padding (it was 96px, which sat the text column 16px inside every other scene's right edge), and the station row is capped at 1490px and centred — at the 1.18 arrival scale a full-width row threw its outer stations past the frame edge, and 1490 x 1.18 = 1758 keeps the row inside the 80px padding at every scale this scene reaches. Each of the four station thumbnails holds a REAL screen in miniature — a full 460x997 app built from the shared primitives (app-header with the robot mascot, page head, period/tabs, hero, stat cards, deal cards, club rows, navy nav bar) scaled by 0.3587 into a 165x358 phone-shaped thumb. Every figure in them now traces to frame.md's demo table: station 1 prices FOX - פוקס at a ₪1,000 cart with max 3 deals, station 2 shows ₪1,284 saved across 10 מועדונים over 30 ימים with 142 עסקאות / ₪5,630 / 3 linked accounts, station 3 leads with the real Hever (חבר) — Gift Cards deal on FOX - פוקס at 30% in ביגוד ואביזרים, and station 4 ranks Mastercard Israel 29% (10/35 חנויות תואמות) over Isracard TopCash 10% (31/300).
